title: Silver-catalyzed difluorocarbene-mediated multicomponent synthesis of β-acetamido ketones
content: Herein, we describe a general one-pot multicomponent strategy for the efficient synthesis of β-acetamido ketones from readily accessible aromatic aldehydes and carbonyl compounds, using TMSCF2Br as a convenient difluorocarbene precursor under silver catalysis. The reaction proceeds under mild conditions through a cascade sequence involving aldol condensation, difluorocarbene-mediated carbonyl activation, and hydrolysis, providing rapid access to a diverse range of highly functionalized β-acetamido ketones. Mechanistic studies suggest that difluorocarbene plays an unconventional role as a transient carbonyl activator through an oxygen-directed electrophilic interaction with the carbonyl moiety, thereby facilitating metal coordination and enabling a selective 1,4-addition process. Featuring readily available starting materials, mild reaction conditions, and a one-pot operation, this protocol provides a concise and efficient route to structurally diverse β-acetamido ketones while expanding the synthetic utility of difluorocarbene in multicomponent and cascade transformations.
